as_told.title: T. Townsend Brown had visitors land in Zanesville

plain: Small beings are said to have landed in the yard of the American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, got out, and given him information. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had repeated UFO encounters himself, tells Michels he heard this from Timothy Taylor, who was working with Brown's daughter to finish a book about her father. Bledsoe says Taylor told him about "these little things coming and landing in his yard and getting out and giving him information." In a second telling, Bledsoe places the conversation in Zanesville. He says that is where Taylor revealed who he was and told him "the whole story," as much as he would share, about Brown "having visitors come and land." Michels adds another source: Brown's daughter, Linda Brown, did an "ask me anything" session on the website Reddit. In Michels's version she described pale beings coming down and then entering the house, into the kitchen. If the story is true, an inventor of unusual technology was being visited and taught by beings that were not human.
